description.0:
{Reinforcements}

Hero can summon creatures from the closest town garrison once per day.
description.1:
{Basic Reinforcements}

Hero can summon creatures from the closest town garrison up to 2 times per day.
description.2:
{Advanced Reinforcements}

Hero can summon creatures from any town garrison up to 3 times per day.
description.3:
{Expert Reinforcements}

Hero can summon creatures from any town garrison up to 4 times per day.

description.0:
{Blizzard}

Deals 20 × Spell Power + 30 damage to all troops within two hexes of the target, including allies. Surviving troops lose 2 base speed (minimum 1) for the rest of the battle. The penalty cannot be dispelled. Repeated casts deal damage but do not stack or replace the first speed penalty.

{Advanced Blizzard}

Deals 20 × Spell Power + 60 damage to all troops within two hexes of the target, including allies. Surviving troops lose 4 base speed (minimum 1) for the rest of the battle. The penalty cannot be dispelled. Repeated casts deal damage but do not stack or replace the first speed penalty.
description.3:
{Expert Blizzard}

Deals 20 × Spell Power + 120 damage to all troops within two hexes of the target, including allies. Surviving troops lose 4 base speed (minimum 1) for the rest of the battle. The penalty cannot be dispelled. Repeated casts deal damage but do not stack or replace the first speed penalty.

Dialog.Text: Select a town to call for reinforcements:

Error.LastStack: You can't transfer the last stack.
Error.WrongTarget: Only troops borrowed from this town may be moved back. A borrowed stack merged with your hero's original troops must stay with the hero.
Error.NoTown: There is no eligible town from which to call reinforcements.

Reinforcements.LimitMessage: @heroName@ has reached the spell limit of @limit@ casts per day.
Reinforcements.MovementMessage: Your hero is too tired to cast the spell today. Try again tomorrow.
